dailyCompanion.purpose: Exact ordered observations, including warmup year, for separately versioned crop calendars and event timing; no post-harvest inference from annual aggregates

disclosure: Fictional scenario · weather and economic references: Coon Valley, Wisconsin · other parameters are authored game assumptions.

analysisWindow.status: authored fixed analysis calendar, not observed crop phenology

rules.completeness: Every actual calendar day must have PRCP/TMAX/TMIN, no -9999, blank QFLAG, nonblank SFLAG, no P/I measurement flags, nonnegative PRCP and TMIN<=TMAX; preceding seven PRCP days also required. Reject the full year otherwise; no infill.
rules.continuity: Ten adjacent historical calendar years at one station; preceding observed December supplies January antecedent. No repeated/wrapped or spliced years.

dryDay.longestSpellBoundary: reset at May 1; count through September 30

eventSelection.grouping: one event per qualifying day; consecutive events remain ordered
eventSelection.status: authored extraction threshold, not a flood or rain-phase classification

limitations: Station weather is a shared regional reference, not parcel or other-terrain measurement.
Daily precipitation does not establish rain/snow phase, subdaily intensity, flood depth, frequency or damage.
Warm-season rain interpretation and crop/exposure/recovery response belong to separately versioned authored rules.
No soil-water stock, solar or wind generation driver is inferred.
Historical windows are illustrative scenarios, not future climate predictions or independent probability samples.
rules.trace: Retain source flag T; numeric zero represents an unquantified trace, not measured no precipitation.
